idea-plugin.name: Rally Integration
idea-plugin.description:
Rally (Broadcom Agile Central) tool window for IntelliJ IDEA.


Features:

  • View My Tickets, Active Tickets, and In-Progress tickets
  • Search by name or FormattedID
  • Change ticket state (In-Progress, Completed, Defined)
  • Sprint summary with ticket counts and points
  • Open tickets in Rally web interface

Setup:

  1. Open Settings → Tools → Rally
  2. Enter your Rally server URL (e.g., https://rally1.rallydev.com)
  3. Enter your Rally API Key (get it from Rally Profile → API Keys)
  4. Enter your workspace ref, project ref, and username
  5. Click 'Test Connection' to verify
